name: ALT Telecom Public Company Limited
summary: ALT Telecom Public Company Limited engages in the manufacture, installation, maintenance, rental, and sale of telecommunication network equipment in Thailand and internationally. It operates through three segments: Network Equipment and Electricity Meter Distribution, Network Equipment Installation Business, and Network Equipment Rental Business. The company also manufactures, assembles, installs, and distributes electricity meter; and offers telecommunication products comprising fiber optic cables, telecom shelters, antennas, batteries, and other telecommunication equipment, as well as rapid deployment products. In addition, it is involved in the construction of base stations; installation of equipment and optical fiber cables; lease and management of telecommunication basic structures; and sale, installation, and maintenance of electrical equipment and systems. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Bang Kruay, Thailand.
